overview.en: The capybara is the largest living rodent, native to much of South America and strongly associated with wetlands and other water-rich landscapes.
overview.fr: Le capybara est le plus grand rongeur vivant, originaire d’une grande partie de l’Amérique du Sud et étroitement associé aux zones humides et aux paysages riches en eau.

identification.en: Its large barrel-shaped body, blunt muzzle, short legs and sparse coat distinguish it from smaller caviid rodents.
identification.fr: Son grand corps en tonneau, son museau obtus, ses pattes courtes et son pelage clairsemé le distinguent des rongeurs caviidés plus petits.

habitat.en: It uses wetlands, riverbanks and seasonally flooded grasslands, relying on nearby water for cooling and escape from danger.
habitat.fr: Il fréquente les zones humides, les berges et les prairies saisonnièrement inondées, et dépend de l’eau proche pour se rafraîchir et fuir le danger.

diet.en: It grazes mainly on grasses and aquatic plants, with bark and fruit taken less often.
diet.fr: Il broute principalement des herbes et des plantes aquatiques, et consomme plus occasionnellement de l’écorce et des fruits.

behavior.en: When alarmed, it gives a bark-like call and escapes into the water, where it swims and dives well.
behavior.fr: Lorsqu’il est alarmé, il émet un cri rauque semblable à un aboiement puis s’enfuit dans l’eau, où il nage et plonge avec agilité.

reproduction.en: Mating usually takes place in water, and females give birth to litters whose young can join the group soon after birth.
reproduction.fr: L’accouplement a généralement lieu dans l’eau, et les femelles mettent bas des portées dont les petits peuvent rejoindre le groupe peu après la naissance.

ecology.en: The lesser capybara Hydrochoerus isthmius is a close relative in the same genus, but some mammal taxonomies still treat its species status cautiously or include it within H. hydrochaeris.
ecology.fr: Le petit capybara Hydrochoerus isthmius est un proche parent du même genre, mais certaines classifications des mammifères restent prudentes sur son statut spécifique ou l’incluent dans H. hydrochaeris.

conservation.en: The IUCN’s 2016 global assessment lists H. hydrochaeris as Least Concern with a stable trend, while noting local pressures such as hunting.
conservation.fr: L’évaluation mondiale de l’UICN de 2016 classe H. hydrochaeris en préoccupation mineure avec une tendance stable, tout en signalant des pressions locales comme la chasse.

facts: University of Michigan species account covers body form, distribution, wetlands and reproduction.

facts: Global 2016 assessment lists Least Concern and a stable trend, citing broad distribution and protected areas while noting local hunting pressure.

facts: Argentine biodiversity account in Spanish describes feeding on grasses and aquatic plants and alarm escape into water.

facts: Mammal taxonomy database tentatively retains H. isthmius as a species but notes it may be included within H. hydrochaeris.

uncertainties: The IUCN status is from the 2016 assessment, not a new evaluation.
The lesser capybara H. isthmius remains taxonomically unsettled in mammal references; this cross-reference is qualified accordingly.
Breeding varies geographically, so the short statement is general rather than a regional calendar.
review_note: H. isthmius is mentioned cautiously because authorities differ on whether it is distinct or included within H. hydrochaeris.
